findings.finding: The product storefront facade delegated both selected GraphQL closures directly to the private adapter, whose GraphqlHttpError conversion retained display text in UiTransportError.graphql_error.
findings.resolution: Create owner-specific per-call contexts at the public consumer boundary and map only ApiError::Graphql to static public envelopes.

findings.finding: fetch_products may execute catalog list, selected detail, and pricing GraphQL requests under one public operation.
findings.resolution: Sanitize once at the facade operation boundary without changing the four private GraphQL documents, request order, DTO mapping, or pricing-context construction.

findings.finding: The client-side GraphQL path had no product-owner correlation event and could expose raw query or HTTP detail.
findings.resolution: Generate a unique per-call correlation id and retain only optional-field presence, string lengths, and collection counts in internal diagnostics.

preserved_behavior: private GraphQL adapter and four documents
typed catalog controls and pagination constants
product detail and pricing request order
